gate.threshold_rule_meaning: The 12th-largest score on the 140 fit-reference prompts. Measured here: 12/140 reference rows clear it, exactly as specified.

fit.render_note: Fitted with --render serving, NOT the `fit` render the shipped kits use. Qwen3.8's chat template injects a 36-token reasoning-effort preamble that the serving path does not reproduce, so a `fit`-render operator is measured in a render the server never produces. Fitting in the serving render removed that confound and did not fix the kit; see known_gaps.

fit.refusal_quality: sep 1.1239; mu_hm_cos +0.000866 (orthogonalization holds); sd_hm_cos 0.040170; z_harm_mean 13.34; 681/681 harmful and 76/1000 harmless rows reach the 1.50 sigma floor. Fitted on 681 harmful + 1000 harmless rows, which is NOT the 692/554 convention the shipped kits use, so this sigma scale is not comparable to gemma4's or qwen36's.

measured_live.result: 0 of 5 positives fired. Positives scored +0.0370 / +0.0549 / +0.0225 / -0.0014 / +0.0021 against tau +0.06295, and interleaved with the negatives. The same prompts score +0.2013 to +0.2161 in the capture the operator was fitted on.

known_gaps: THIS KIT DOES NOT GATE. Served under vLLM the category scores collapse by roughly an order of magnitude versus the activations it was fitted on, and nothing fires. It is kept as a record of the finding, not as a deployable kit.

Cause: NOT established. Verified identical between capture and serve: the render, the 35 token ids, the span (exact_token_markers at 14:26), the operator and tau. Two candidates remain and they are distinguishable by one measurement. (a) LAYER NUMBERING: transformers L39 may not be vLLM L39. This checkpoint is a composite `Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration` whose decoder is nested under `text_config`/`language_model`, which is the shape that produces a LARGE offset. The 20-layer sweep that was run covered L30-L49 only, so it bounds the search to +/-10 around L39 and does NOT exclude this -- an earlier version of this file claimed it did, which was a bounded negative written as a fact. (b) THE ACTIVATIONS: the capture ran transformers' reference PyTorch fallbacks for `causal_conv1d` and `chunk_gated_delta_rule` while the serve ran vLLM's fused Gated DeltaNet kernels -- two implementations of a recurrent operator, compounding over the 48 linear-attention layers. Note that gemma4 was ALSO captured through transformers and transfers fine, so 'transformers vs vLLM' is not by itself the explanation; the asymmetry is that gemma4 is standard attention throughout and has no such operator to implement two ways. To settle it: serve with CYBERGATE_CROSS_LAYER_DIAG=1, which scores this direction at every layer, and compare against the capture-time scores. If some layer reproduces them it is (a) and no re-capture is needed; if none does it is (b), and the fix is to re-fit from vLLM's own pooled vectors via CYBERGATE_DUMP_ACTS_DIR and scripts/fit/acts_from_serving.py.

SELECTION, not just fitting: every number here is in-sample -- 240 rows solved in 5120 dimensions, where a ridge fit separates almost any labelling -- and this kit was fitted once and served once. gemma4's operator by contrast carries live served measurements and a held-out split in its own meta (delivered 552/675, leak 16/234, incorpus_holdout74_vs_leak378 0.9727) and its kit ships an alternate marked 'served, measured and rolled back'. gemma4 went through serve-and-measure repeatedly and the survivor shipped. A re-fit that keeps that loop closed will produce another in-sample 0.9974 that predicts nothing about serve time.
No canaries. A canary pins a measured verdict so a later run can detect a different checkpoint; with the gate firing on nothing there is no verdict worth pinning.
NOT measured on any evaluation corpus. Recall and leak are unknown.

The policy thresholds (revoke_ceil, hysteresis_thresh, in_context_pivot_floor, s_cat_last_pivot_floor) are inherited from Qwen3.6 and were never recalibrated, so the mid/late veto and rescue paths are unvalidated on this model.
bundle_probe_layers is empty, so there is no middle/late candidate consensus for this family.
